M-A.scope: Source public Pokémon-page aggregates and published team selections

denominators.abilities: Source: tournament teams containing this Pokémon; pre-Mega ability selections retained.
denominators.natures: Source: tournament and featured community sets with a known nature.
denominators.spreads: Source: complete nonzero point spreads, separate from overall nature usage.
denominators.pointAllocation: Featured-team allocated points in this stat / allocated points across all six stats. The +number is the modal investment, not its frequency.
denominators.moves: Source move-share percentages (not percentage of Pokémon). Source does not publish the denominator count; approximately sums to 100% across move entries.
denominators.teammates: Source co-occurring teams / teams containing the selected Pokémon. Base/Mega rows overlap and must not be added.
